title: Opt-in tick-history capture gating
condition: Verify the emulation pump does not capture when recording is disabled (default) and that GetTickHistory arms recording.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Pump_DoesNotCaptureHistory_WhenRecordingDisabled - default off yields empty history after pumping.
GetTickHistory_ArmsHistoryRecording - calling the RPC sets HistoryRecordingEnabled true.
